verdict.rationale: The only evidence is community hands-on comments. They show Figma itself can export individual assets: users click each asset and export it as SVG, and a native 'Copy as SVG' action exists. Bulk export depends on a third-party plugin, which earns no credit here, and there is no first-party documentation of the export system. Missing for 10: first-party export docs, evidence of PNG/PDF and other formats, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers, slices, and native bulk export.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices

citations.quote: I have to click on each asset, name it properly, and then export it.
Right Click the icon > Copy/Paste as > Copy as SVG.
